name: Bullet Cart[New Careers]
desc:
Welcome to the Bullet Cart!
The Gold Rush has turned the frontier into a lawless battleground! Hop into a rickety, weaponized mine cart with your crew and race through treacherous terrain. Collect gold, fend off bandits, and outrun rivals to claim the ultimate treasure at the finish line—if you survive!

🔫【Gameplay】

🚂 Breakneck Speed
💥 High-Stakes Shootouts
💰 Risk vs. Reward
🤠 Team Up or Betray

New code: MORERACE, BUGWASFIXED

🚨【Warning】
“Bullets fly faster than rumors in a saloon!”
